about_story_1: WM_CHECKLIST started from a simple personal need. I use Capacities for general notes, but for everyday purchase tracking, planning, installments, and credit limits I wanted a dedicated, fast, distraction-free tool.
about_story_2: Most existing apps either lock features behind subscriptions or clutter the screen with ads. So I built this tracker for myself first — zero servers, zero tracking, zero ads — and open-sourced it for free on GitHub. Fork it, customize it, or share your ideas anytime.
about_donate_desc: WM_CHECKLIST is completely free with no ads or subscriptions. If it saves you time or money, you can thank the author here:
backup_banner_sub: Your data lives locally in your browser — download a fresh .json in 1 click.
tour_s1_text: WM_CHECKLIST has no backend server or hidden accounts. All tabs, items, and notes stay locally in your browser and work completely offline as a PWA.
tour_s2_text: Organize lists by tabs (Home, Work, Tech), collapse categories, use the pinned ⊞ All view on the left, and search everything instantly with Ctrl+K or /.
tour_s3_text: Group items across any tabs into shared credits or installments, track monthly load, overpayment, and remaining card limit in the Credits panel.
tour_s4_text: Want multi-device sync? Open Settings → Sync and connect GitHub Gist, GitLab Snippets (up to 50 MB), or Dropbox (2 GB + WebP photo uploads) — edits merge automatically even after working offline.

privacy_intro: WM_CHECKLIST is an open-source static web application (PWA) with no backend server. The author does not collect, store, or have access to any of your personal data.
privacy_l1_1: All tabs, categories, items, notes, prices, credits, and preferences are stored locally in your browser localStorage.
privacy_l1_2: If you enable cloud sync (GitHub Secret Gist, GitLab Private Snippets, or Dropbox App Folder), your browser communicates directly with your own personal account at that provider.
privacy_l1_3: Access tokens (GitHub PAT, GitLab PAT, or Dropbox OAuth) stay strictly in your local browser storage and are never sent anywhere else.
privacy_p2: This app uses zero ad networks, zero analytics scripts, and zero tracking cookies. Fonts and assets are bundled locally for full offline privacy.
privacy_p3: External links and image URLs are fetched directly from third-party domains. When uploading photos via Dropbox, images are resized and re-encoded to WebP locally in your browser (stripping all EXIF/GPS metadata) before upload to your private App Folder.
privacy_p4: You can export your data to .json or erase everything anytime via Settings → Sync → Clear All, clear your browser storage, or delete your personal Secret Gist on GitHub.

guide_modal_title_github: How to connect GitHub Secret Gist
guide_modal_title_gitlab: How to connect GitLab Private Snippets
guide_modal_title_dropbox: How to connect Dropbox (with photo uploads)
guide_gh_s1: Open GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Tokens (classic) and click "Generate new token (classic)".
guide_gh_s2: Check only the "gist" scope and choose an expiration period.
guide_gh_s3: Copy the token (ghp_...) and paste it above. Click "Find my Gist" or "Push to cloud ↑".
guide_gh_note: Limits: up to 10 MB per JSON file; photos are attached via external URLs only.
guide_gl_s1: Open GitLab Personal access tokens and click "Generate token ▾" (top-right of the table) → "Fine-grained token" (recommended; or "Legacy token" with the "api" scope).
guide_gl_s2: Set a Name and Expiration date (up to 365 days). Skip "Group and project access". Under "Add resource permissions", switch to the "User" tab, pick "Snippet", check Create, Read, Update, and click "Generate token".
guide_gl_s3: Copy the token (glpat-...) and paste it above. Click "Find Snippet" (if you already have one) or "Push to cloud ↑" — a private snippet is created automatically.
guide_gl_note: Advantage: up to 50 MB per file and native CORS. Photos are attached via external URLs.
guide_dbx_s1: For regular users, no setup is needed: simply click "Sign in with Dropbox" and allow access to the isolated /Apps/WM_CHECKLIST folder.
guide_dbx_s2: If you run a fork or prefer your own key: in Dropbox App Console create an app (Scoped access → App folder) and enable account_info.read, files.metadata.read, files.content.write, files.content.read.
guide_dbx_s3: Add your site URL to Redirect URIs (OAuth 2), paste your App key under "Custom App Key", and click "Sign in with Dropbox".
guide_dbx_note: Advantage: 2 GB free, non-expiring refresh token, and direct photo uploads (client-side 1280px WebP compression + EXIF removal).
